title: Universal Life Insurance Policy Accounting Standard: Booking the Full-Surrender Charge
content:
## Standard

When a signed full surrender of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy is processed, the surrender charge is booked in the policy's activity history as a full-surrender charge on the surrender request, dated the day it is assessed. The entry carries the reason full surrender and the reference of the owner's surrender request, so that the activity history shows which surrender request the charge belongs to.

| Element | As booked |
|---|---|
| Where | The policy's activity history |
| Kind of entry | A surrender charge entry with the reason full surrender |
| Tied to | The owner's surrender request |
| Dated | The day the charge is assessed |

## Charge booking tool: `assess_surrender_charge_840d0421`

**Capability.** Books the full-surrender charge on an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy being surrendered. One call adds one surrender charge entry, dated today, to the policy's activity history with the reason `full_surrender`, tied to the owner's surrender request and carrying the charge as given; nothing else on the policy changes.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ul_policy_id` | The reference number of the universal life policy being surrendered, read from the universal life policy lookup | Identifier, as recorded |
| `ul_request_id` | The reference number of the owner's surrender request the charge belongs to, read from the universal life service request lookup | Identifier, as recorded |
| `surrender_charge` | The full-surrender charge to deduct | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half-up to the cent; zero or greater |

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `ul_txn_id` (the reference number of the charge entry), `ul_policy_id` (the policy), `ul_request_id` (the surrender request), `surrender_charge` (the charge booked, USD with 2 decimal places) and `status`, which reads `charge_booked` when the entry was added. No other return is defined.

## Questions answered

**May a charge of zero be booked?** Yes; the tool accepts a charge of zero or more, so a surrender whose charge comes to nothing is still booked as a full-surrender charge entry of 0.00.

**Does booking the charge end the policy?** No. Booking the charge changes nothing else on the policy.
